aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer, including lethal prostate cancer; the abstract does not further define advanced or lethal disease.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: During follow-up, a total of 857 incident cases of advanced PCa, including 425 lethal PCa were documented.
study_design: Prospective cohort study within the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial
cohort_total_n_excerpt: This prospective cohort included 49 424 men from the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial.
reason: The initially followed cohort accrued incident advanced prostate cancer, including lethal prostate cancer. These are aggressive incident endpoints. The abstract does not clearly report an analysis of total prostate cancer incidence.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: No significant associations were found between LFDs and the risk of advanced and lethal PCa.
estimate_classifications.reason: The low-fat diet score was explicitly evaluated in relation to advanced and lethal prostate cancer. The abstract reports the association qualitatively without an effect estimate and confidence interval.
